review.instruction: Review the pull request identified by run_input in github_repository against its description, plus the operator request if one is given. Leave files unchanged. Return concrete findings in your human-readable message. Do not post to GitHub.

argv:
import json, subprocess, sys
context = json.load(sys.stdin)
body = context["inputs"][0]["message"]
url = subprocess.run(["gh", "pr", "comment", str(context["run_input"]["number"]), "--repo", context["github_repository"], "--body-file", "-"],
                     input=body, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
print(json.dumps({"message": "Posted review comment", "data": {"url": url}}))
